evidence_set: At week 3 against 12 healthy men: group differences in slow-wave sleep (F(2,29) = 4.9, p = 0.015), REM time (3.5, p = 0.04), total sleep (12.1, p < 0.0001) and sleep onset latency (4.7, p = 0.017); post hoc, REM time was lower and sleep latency longer in the placebo group (not the modafinil group) than in the healthy men; self-rated sleep quality did not differ (placebo 77, modafinil 81, healthy men 67; p = 0.16).

The healthy men lived outside the unit, received no morning medication or placebo and were recorded on a single night after one adaptation night; the authors name the fixed bedtime, uncontrolled daytime light, few non-treatment-seeking participants and possible withdrawal from other substances as limitations, and say the findings reproduce their 2006 study.
